sloka: तेषां तु रथघोषेण राक्षसानां महात्मनाम्।वानराणामपि चमूर्युद्धायैवाभ्यवर्तत ।। ६.९६.४१ ।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ tu rathaghoṣeṇa rākṣasānāṁ mahātmanām।vānarāṇāmapi camūryuddhāyaivābhyavartata ।। 6.96.41 ।।

translations.english: There the tenheaded Ravana using arrows adorned with gold plumes struck Vanaras and a great war took place.
